sara_product: Heads up — Support flagged multiple customers seeing "fallback invoked" messages with no clear reason in Console. They want a pointer whether it was a schema reject vs model failure.
infra-bot: ALERT: metric=structured_output_rejects count=48 window=15m route=fn-action cluster=b. trace_id=tr-1768b.
sara_product: Here's one customer payload from logs (sanitized):
```json
{"tool_response": {"calls": [ {"op":"read_file","params":{"path":"/var/log/app.log"}} ]}}
```
jin_dev: Validator expected `tool_response` to be an object with a single `call` object, not an object containing `calls` array. Error shows `schema_error: unexpected_array`. Looks like an adapter version mismatch.
mike_w: Are these causing fallback routing to the degen variant? We need to know what customers were billed for on those timestamps.
alex_billing: Billing currently charges based on the final model that returned output. But logs sometimes attribute tokens to the initial request for observability which confuses support. We should emit a `billing_hint` field on the invocation event if a fallback happens so downstream billing can use that as the source of truth.
jin_dev: Agreed. Also propose adding `reject_class` to event telemetry (values like `validator:unexpected_array`, `parser:invalid_json`, `adapter:missing_field`) so dashboards can filter by reason.
sara_product: UX proposal: In Console show a subtle pill: `Reject: validator:unexpected_array` next to the invoke row. Clicking expands a sampled payload and a human-friendly explanation and a suggested remediation (e.g., "upgrade adapter v1.3"). Make it off by default for all tenants and opt-in per-route via a toggle.
ksenia_sre: To debug, can we bump sampling for the impacted tenant/route from 1% to 7% for 24h? We'll need to ensure PII is scrubbed before storing. I'll add a retention policy and scrubber rule.
\mike_w: Make it per-tenant plus route-level flag. Also add an alert if `reject_rate` increases >200% for any route in a 10m window.
alex_billing: If we add `billing_hint`, we need a small migration in billing infra to prefer it when present. I'll start an RFC with billing infra — if accepted, we can emit it immediately and stage the billing change later.
jin_dev: Implementation plan: 1) event schema bump to include optional `reject_class` and `billing_hint`. 2) instrument invocation pipeline to set `billing_hint` when fallback occurs (and include final model id). 3) validator to tag rejects with class codes. 4) Console feature-flag for the reject pill and sampling toggle. I'll open PRs for schema + pipeline.
sara_product: I'll mock the pill + details drawer and add copy for the support playbook describing the difference between "reject" and "fallback".
ksenia_sre: Done — increasing sampling for tenant=acme-corp route=fn-action to 7% now. Added scrubber rule to remove file contents and `path` values from stored payloads.
alex_billing: Noted. Filing RFC with billing infra; will ping when we have signoff.
mike_w: Thanks. Can we also add a short Console tooltip explaining that rejects may cause a fallback and that billing_hint (if present) indicates which model was charged? Default tooltip off for legacy customers.
sara_product: Yup — will include tooltip copy in mocks.
jin_dev: Action items summarised: (1) PR: schema optional fields (`reject_class`, `billing_hint`) — jin. (2) Console mocks + playbook copy — sara. (3) Sampling bump + scrubber — ksenia. (4) Billing RFC — alex. (5) Alert rule for reject_rate spike — mike.
sara_product: I'll put mocks in the design channel and link here. Target: ship feature-gated Console view + telemetry in canary to internal teams next week.
mike_w: Great. Follow up sync after 24h of higher sampling. :thumbsup:
